response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, hands-on senior engineer with nearly two decades of experience, solid fundamentals, open-source contributions, and some high-scale systems exposure (low-latency services handling millions of requests per second at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic). However, the role is a Principal/IC6 position centered on growth and experimentation systems, and the resume shows no evidence of building experimentation platforms, A/B testing frameworks, feature-flagging systems, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or statistical analysis work. Career progression has remained at senior/staff IC level in small-to-mid-size companies, without demonstrated multi-workstream, cross-org technical leadership at the scope this role demands.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering experience (15+ years) across web, backend, mobile, and embedded systems
High-scale distributed systems exposure, including low-latency services handling millions of requests per second
Strong craftsmanship culture: TDD, CI/CD, open-source authorship, teaching, and mentoring via workshops
concerns: No experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flighting, or growth-measurement platform experience evident
No demonstrated telemetry/metrics infrastructure or statistical/experimental analysis background
Scope gap for Principal/IC6: no track record of leading multi-team, cross-product initiatives at enterprise scale

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering fundamentals and scale exposure
